ai_summary: Archidply Decor Limited has announced the resignation of Mr. Kukkehalli Raviraj Hegde, an Independent Director, effective September 9, 2026, citing personal health reasons. Mr. Hegde explicitly confirmed there are no other material reasons for his departure, which mitigates potential concerns typically associated with director resignations. The company will now address the resulting changes in its board and committee composition, representing a standard governance adjustment.
